statement: A principal's inability to reach one authorized interface must never block a constitutional act available through another authorized interface. Where a principal has a genuine authorized delegated-agent relationship (e.g. a Copilot session admitted via MCP), that channel is a first-class way to exercise the SAME constitutional acts native UI exercises -- not a lesser or provisional one -- provided the same evidentiary burden (explicit consent, verified eligibility, canonical write) is met.
classification: Reframes 'interface unavailable' from a blocker into a routing question: which authorized channel is reachable, not whether the constitutional act can happen at all. Distinguishes CUSTODY (an operator may register an artifact on a principal's explicit, out-of-band authorization, pending that principal's own later attestation) from CONSTITUTIONAL ACTS proper (confirm, freeze, sign -- which a delegated agent may transmit but never infer), per CI-2026-08-28-CHANNEL-INDEPENDENT-PROVENANCE-PRESERVING-001.

canaries.assertion: ensureBoundaryResearchExchangeMembershipOperatorAssisted() admits a verified-eligible principal to the same exchange membership their own self-service path would produce, and refuses an ineligible one with the same reason codes the self-service path already returns -- proving the operator-assisted route is equivalent, not a separate weaker admission.

Delegation established via the MCP-path function is immediately reflected as delegationEstablished:true by the Journey Spine resolver's own read -- proving Copilot-mediated delegation is not a second-tier act awaiting bridge confirmation.

occurrences.defect: Ian's own bridge crossing was blocked by a separate, unrelated defect (/bridge/ocsga reload loop), and the exchange model had no way to distinguish 'the principal cannot reach this interface right now' from 'the principal has not authorized this act' -- both read, structurally, as simply blocked.

notes: The operator directed this be treated as ratified doctrine effective 2026-08-28. Recorded at 'candidate' per this repo's consistent convention -- see the governing principle's own note for the ratifiedSource update path.

This does NOT license an operator or agent to perform an act ON a principal's behalf merely because the principal is unreachable -- see CI-2026-08-28-CHANNEL-INDEPENDENT-PROVENANCE-PRESERVING-001 for the custody/consent boundary this principle does not erase.

2026-08-29: the operator's ratification directive committed this candidate's governing doctrine as canon at inv.constitutional.363 (the Channel Rule) and inv.constitutional.369 (Principal-Only Constitutional Acts) in codexes/packs/irl/foundation/appendix-a_canonical-invariants.md -- a direct operator act with no accumulated-evidence gate. This candidate remains 'candidate' here: only one occurrence is recorded, and this pipeline's ladder discipline (services/invariants/resolutionRecords.ts) blocks 'validated'-or-above on fewer than two occurrences regardless of the canon ratification.
